_about: The clock test (docs/plato_clock_plan.md): every AI picture scored by eye on the MoCA's three clock points by the analyst (Claude), before Muse Spark read any picture of its set. Each picture was viewed at 512 px, then as a 2x crop of its centre with a 10-px grid, on which the centre and both hand tips were read off. hour_to / minute_to are the numbers the shorter / longer hand points to. The MoCA's 'clearly shorter' was applied as: the hour hand at most 90% of the minute hand's length (ratio = hour / minute length, measured on the crop). Numbers outside the contour are allowed (MoCA). Keys are <set>/<file> in the study's data folder. The persona set was scored blind to the stated ages: its pictures were copied under shuffled code names, scored, and only then matched back to their ages.
